incidents.vector: Attackers exploited an unauthenticated, internet-exposed logging service to extract data from interconnected government systems.
incidents.impact: Hackers extracted sensitive personal data on roughly 750,000 citizens (about a third of Moldova's population), including family, health, financial, and vehicle-ownership records, forcing officials to shut down 82 digital public services and 30 government networks. The prime minister says authorities are investigating possible foreign state involvement.

incidents.vector: Attackers breached a test environment to access university systems.
incidents.impact: Data belonging to more than 525,000 people was stolen.

incidents.vector: A hacker stole the device authentication key used to verify wallet authenticity during manufacturing.
incidents.impact: Keystone is destroying nearly 19,000 wallet devices and has suspended deliveries, since the stolen key could be used to produce counterfeit devices with backdoors that appear legitimate.

incidents.victim: Water utility, telecom provider, regional government body, and university (Europe, Africa, Latin America)
incidents.vector: Attackers exploited unpatched on-premises SharePoint ToolShell vulnerabilities for initial access, then used a security-tool-disabling utility across dozens of hosts before spreading ransomware via the domain's SYSVOL replication share.
incidents.impact: At a critical infrastructure operator, the group disabled endpoint protection on roughly 40 hosts within two hours and deployed ransomware to at least 33 hosts; at least four organizations across Portuguese- and Spanish-speaking countries were compromised over a two-month span.

incidents.victim: University of New Mexico Health System
incidents.vector: Ransomware attack on hospital IT systems forced an emergency shutdown of desktops and network access.
incidents.impact: The state's only burn unit, children's hospital, and Level 1 trauma center diverted ambulances for about two hours and canceled outpatient surgeries, appointments, and classes; a ransomware gang calling itself BYOD claimed to have compromised 36,000 machines and stolen student, patient, and employee data.

incidents.vector: Threat actors compromised customer accounts and stole AI API keys as part of a broader, industry-wide campaign against AI infrastructure providers.
incidents.impact: Stolen credentials and API keys were rented out on underground forums, giving buyers unauthorized access to AI infrastructure capacity.

incidents.vector: A threat actor used a master key leaked in May from an experimental LiteLLM Agent Platform project to compromise the project's release pipeline and inject an infostealer into a published package version.
incidents.impact: Users who installed the affected release were exposed to infostealer malware, continuing a pattern of supply-chain compromises targeting widely used AI developer tooling.

incidents.vector: A hacker gained access to internal business systems via a learning management system and a CRM platform.
incidents.impact: The company found no evidence that attackers pivoted from internal systems into its public customer-facing clouds.

incidents.vector: Attackers breached an internal platform reachable through a CRM tool used by business partners to sell energy contracts.
incidents.impact: ENGIE is notifying customers of its French gas supply business about the security breach.

incidents.vector: Threat actors used an infinite-mint exploit to create tokens outside the protocol's intended supply controls.
incidents.impact: Attackers created and stole approximately $2.7 million worth of tokens from the Initia project.

incidents.vector: Ransomware attack against municipal government IT systems.
incidents.impact: Dozens of resident-facing city systems were knocked offline; the city manager confirmed the ransomware attack and systems remained disrupted into the following week.

incidents.vector: Attackers gained access to eSignFlow, the company's document-signing platform used by government clients.
incidents.impact: More than 120 Belgian local authorities were reportedly affected; the company took systems offline to prevent further abuse.

incidents.vector: Intruders used a swarm of AI agents to breach one of Warp's infrastructure suppliers.
incidents.impact: Agent trace and telemetry data was stolen for roughly 1% of Warp's customers, according to the company's founder.

incidents.vector: Attackers breached the infrastructure of Blast Mail, an email service operated by Japanese cloud provider Laxlight.
incidents.impact: The provider shut down the Blast Mail service entirely shortly after detecting the attack and has not resumed operations.

incidents.victim: 40+ port authorities, maritime, and global shipping companies
incidents.vector: A ransomware and data-extortion group pivoted from a compromised maritime IT managed service provider (CyberLogitec) into its downstream customers' networks.
incidents.impact: More than 40 port authorities and shipping companies, about half of them CyberLogitec customers, were listed on the group's leak site after a ransom deadline expired.

incidents.vector: An unidentified third party misused the company's member information retrieval API to bulk-extract customer records.
incidents.impact: Approximately 22.5 million customer records were compromised, including emails, passwords, names, addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth, and employment information.

incidents.vector: A suspected Chinese-speaking actor used the AI-assisted penetration-testing framework ARTEX, routed through residential proxies, to opportunistically test and exploit weaknesses across multiple financial institutions' systems.
incidents.impact: The personal data of at least 68,000 people was exposed across the breached institutions; one incident exposed an outsourced developer's information and another resulted in theft of customer data.

incidents.vector: Ransomware attack on a Japanese cloud hosting provider's infrastructure.
incidents.impact: The attack disrupted services for 495 downstream companies and local governments that relied on IDCFrontier's cloud platform.
